hooks.command: jq -r '.prompt // empty' | { read -r p; echo "## $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') | prompt"; echo "> ${p:0:500}"; echo ""; } >> LOGS.md
jq -r '[.tool_name, (.tool_input | tostring)] | join(" | ")' | { read -r line; echo "## $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') | tool | $line"; echo ""; } >> LOGS.md
